final_text_coverage.remaining_claim_scope: Literary/source-text comparison only. No new primary-literature verification; substantive source, clinical, historical and mathematical holds retained.

applied_repairs.reason: Major/Minor Arcana conflation removed; interpretive state-verification claim owned. Final Justice section and closing context reread.

corpus_adjacent_template_assessment.coverage: All24 candidate bodies and all replaced/deleted source passages independently read; finalprimaryhashes bound.

final_repair_scope: All exact proposed replacements applied by parent and reread with adjacent final-primary context. Report hashes rebound. These local repairs do not erase source-review holds or establish publication readiness.
